stem: A manufacturer collects millions of timestamped sensor readings per hour from factory equipment and wants a fully managed, purpose-built time-series database that is open to new customers today.
rationale: Timestream for InfluxDB is AWS's current, purpose-built time-series offering and is open to new customers today. Timestream for LiveAnalytics is also a real, existing time-series database, but it stopped accepting new customers in mid-2025, so it fails the requirement to be open to new customers even though the underlying workloads it once targeted still exist. Neptune is a graph database built for traversing relationships, and Keyspaces is a wide-column, Cassandra-compatible database; neither is purpose-built for timestamped metrics at high ingest volume.
